column1: # Chat and tech words for the English typing model (build-typing-model.py), written for Hex
# by its developers: ours, not copied from any corpus, dictionary or other keyboard.
# Each line: word<TAB>tier. Tier 1 costs 10 nats (about the model's 2,000th word), tier 2
# 12, tier 3 13.5; a word the books already have only gets commoner. Lowercase a-z and '
# only, no brand or product names (the model is lowercase; their capitals come from elsewhere).
